title: petasites nivalis subsp. hyperboreus
intro: Petasites nivalis subsp. hyperboreus, commonly known as Arctic butterbur or Snow butterbur, is a subspecies of the Petasites nivalis plant, a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of migraines and menopause. The therapeutic actions of Petasites nivalis subsp. hyperboreus are attributed to its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, reduce spasms, and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
